record: Huntington Museum of Art archive on Walter Gropius and the 1968 addition
facts: Walter Gropius and The Architects Collaborative designed the museum's 1968 addition and studios.
The C. Fred Edwards Conservatory opened in 1996. It is a botanical greenhouse connected to the museum.
